name: Ollama
description: Local LLM inference against an Ollama host. No API key — the host URL is the only required field, and it stays on the machine running Ollama. Serves as an agent runtime backend and as a callable chat integration.

credential_fields.name: host
credential_fields.label: Ollama host
credential_fields.description: Base URL of your Ollama server, e.g. http://localhost:11434

tools.name: chat_completion
tools.description: Create a chat completion via POST /v1/chat/completions on the Ollama host. OpenAI-compatible request and response shape.

model.description: Model name as pulled into Ollama, e.g. llama3.3. Call list_models for what is installed.

messages.description: Conversation so far, as OpenAI-style {role, content} objects.

role.description: One of system, user, assistant, tool.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List models installed on this Ollama host via GET /api/tags.
